title: Real-model baseline, v1.0.0
what_this_is: One real-model run of each of the 22 scenarios on the invented mock system, scored by evals/run_evals.py. A baseline, not an accuracy claim.
how_it_was_scored: Required phrases also match plain paraphrases and the tool's own template ids (see PHRASE_ALTERNATIVES in evals/run_evals.py). That rule was written after the first round and applied to all saved reports offline, so the first-round reports were re-scored without a new model call.
notes: Spend is an estimate from the PRICE_*_PER_MTOK settings; the provider's usage page is the record.
Scenarios run in two rounds changed score between rounds (S5, S6, S7), so one run is not stable evidence.
The per-tool-call results were not saved in these runs, only the tool names and the final reports.
